Appointment log • Medication list • Provider directory • Insurance tracker
  
  
Fill in the fields on screen, then print (Ctrl+P / Cmd+P) or save as PDF. Everything stays on your computer — nothing is uploaded, and no account is needed.

1. Appointment Log

A running list of visits so you can spot patterns, track follow-ups, and remember what was discussed. Fill in one row per appointment.

After each visit, jot down: what the provider said, new medicines or changes, tests ordered and when results are due, and your next appointment date.

4. Insurance Tracker

Keep your health insurance details in one place: plan info, costs, claims, and renewal dates. Update it when your plan changes or at open enrollment.
